title.en: Watashi wo Dekiaishi Sugiru Danna-sama wa Konya mo Furete Kuremasen
Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu
"Raise de Kekkon shite kuremasu ka" to Chikatta Buka ga, Gense de wa Toshiue no Kishi Danchou-sama ni Natte Ite, Hontou ni Kekkon wo Semararete Iru Ken
Himegimi wa Wakaki Shougun ni Oboreru
Uranaishi ni wa Hana Kishi no Koigokoro ga Mieteimasu
Umagoya Kurashi no Goreijou wa Angai Ryoushu ni Muiteiru?
Hameraremashita ga, Shiawase ni narimashita - Kizumono Reijou to Hidamari no Madoushi
Botsuraku Reijou desu ga, Kono Tabi Tsundere Kishi-sama no Koibito Yaku ni narimashita
Kodomo Atsukai Shinaide Kudasai! - Youjoka Shichatta Kanpeki Shukujo wa, Kishi Danchou ni Amayakasareru
Tensei Aka-chan Katy wa Chouhou Katsudou Shiteimasu - Soshite Kichiku na Chichi ni Dekiai Sareteiru you desu
Doku-suki Reijou wa Kekkon ni Tadoritsukai
Me no Mae no Sangeki de Zense wo Omoidashitakedo, Amarini mo Mondai Yamazumi de Ippai Ippaidesu.
Ane no Koto ga Sukina Hittou Majutsushi-sama ni Migawari de Totsuidara, Naze ka Watashi ga Dekiai saremashita!? ~Munou Reijou wa Kuni Ichiban no Kekkai Majutsushi ni Kaika suru~
Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~
